newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega shares jump on MHI tie-up report.
newsitem.headline: Sega shares jump on MHI tie-up report.

text.p: Shares in video game firm Sega Enterprises Ltd jumped on Wednesday morning, cheered by a newspaper report saying it planned a tie-up with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd (MHI) to develop high-tech attractions for theme parks, traders said.
Sega's share price was up 150 yen at 3,610 yen at 0057 GMT, after briefly touching 3,630 yen. Volume was 98,500 shares.

The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that the first cooperation between the two companies would be in interactive equipment being developed by MHI in space craft and aircraft simulators for which Sega would provide software.
MHI told Reuters on Wednesday that it and Sega would start negotiations over a possible tie-up to develop high-tech attractions for theme parks.
